spans.s: कुज m. 1. A tree; 2. the planet Mars; 3. name of a demon killed by Kṛṣṇa (also called नरक).
कुजा f. An epithet of Sītā.
कूज m. 1. Cooing, warbling; 2. the rattling of wheels.
कुजंभन m. A thief who breaks into a house.
कुजंभन m. A thief who breaks into a house.
कुज्झटि f. A fog or mist.

कूज् vi. 1P (pp. कूजित) To make any inarticulate sound, to coo, to warble, चुकूज कूले कलहंसमंडली Na.i.127, पुंस्कोकिलो यन्मधुरं चुकूज K.S.iii.32, Rt.vi.22, R.ii.12.With नि-, परि-, or वि-, to coo, to make an indistinct noise.
कूजन n. 1. Cooing, warbling; 2. the rattling of wheels.
कूजित n. 1. Cooing, warbling; 2. the rattling of wheels.
